reference: Power et al. (2022), arXiv:2201.02177; context only, not exact replication

data.train_selection: first 2822 entries of a uniform permutation of all 9409 pairs

backend_selection: pilot correctness and throughput only; dense CPU faster than gather; MPS unavailable under provided memory configuration

primary_transition.time_definition: first evaluation in qualifying consecutive run

uncertainty: seed-level mean and two-sided 95% Student t interval; df=3 when all four pairs complete
auxiliary_inference: exact 16 paired sign flips of absolute mean difference
execution_order: ascending seed, weight decay 0 then 1; finish or resource-resume each cell before proceeding
resource_stop_policy: retain actual updates and censoring; never relabel a truncated run as a 100000-update confirmation endpoint
